changes.comment: The recursive jsonObject, jsonArray and jsonValue converters and validators fail at once on a cyclic input with 'circular reference at $.path', instead of recursing until the stack is exhausted. Their failure messages, and those of jsonPrimitive, literal and enumeratedValue, format the offending value with formatValueForMessage, and classifyJsonValue returns a Failure instead of throwing for a Proxy whose traps throw. Text is unchanged for inputs that previously rendered without throwing.
